newsitem.title: UK: Blair is a chameleon, UK's Major says.
newsitem.headline: Blair is a chameleon, UK's Major says.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said opposition Labour leader Tony Blair was a chameleon who tailored his views to suit his audience.
"He's a chameleon, isn't he, as far as politics is concerned?" he told BBC television.

"It really depends which part of the country he's in and which day of the week it is. The oratory that ue uses is an oratory pitched to appeal to the instincts of Britain, which is a conservative -- with a small "C' -- country."
Major rejected suggestions that the Conservatives and Labour had become almost indistinguishable

"Once one strips away the surface oratory and looks at the detail of the policies of the two major parties, they're quite different. The Labour party neither could nor would carry forward the improvements we've made in the last 18 years."
